Business Analyst Portfolio / Project

Bringing structure to Agile delivery

ManSci Professional Services DMCC

From ambiguous requests to a shared delivery commitment.

100+ requirements / month35 client accounts7-day sprint cycles

The starting point

Requests arrived without a consistent record of scope, amendments or delivery timelines.

How I led the change

I introduced structured requirements capture, refinement with developers, backlog prioritisation, sequencing, client approvals and acceptance criteria. I trained client-facing and development teams and connected the process to a delivery dashboard.

What changed

Every new request now follows the mandatory process. Teams can see workload, approvals, backlog, amendments and testing status, while clients receive clearer delivery expectations.

Requirements discoveryBRD / FRDBacklog refinementAcceptance criteriaSprint planningTraining & adoption

Delivery path: Requirements → Refinement → Backlog → Sprint → UAT

Turning incidents into lasting improvement

ManSci Professional Services DMCC

A faster response today. A stronger process tomorrow.

40% fewer incidents reportedWeekly incident reviews24-hour corrective-action target

The starting point

Incident handling needed clear ownership, consistent investigation and a way to prevent repeat problems.

How I led the change

I established a central incident platform, trained teams, introduced weekly reviews and a 24-hour corrective-action target. Permanent preventive measures followed investigation, project planning and approval.

What changed

Resolution became faster and incidents reduced by a reported 40% after the process was implemented. Weekly reviews made improvement an ongoing responsibility.

Process designIncident ownershipRoot-cause analysisWeekly governanceChange adoption
